paper_title: Search for sub-eV axion-like particles in a quasi-parallel stimulated resonant photon-photon collider with "coronagraphy"
coupling_convention: g/M in GeV^-1 (ALP-photon coupling as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 11)
notes: SAPPHIRES02 stimulated resonant photon-photon collider (laboratory search, model-independent, no DM assumption). Null result sets a new 95% CL exclusion region in the g/M vs m plane for both scalar and pseudoscalar ALPs (Figs. 10-11), covering roughly 1e-3 to ~1 eV in mass. Only one explicit numerical value is given in the text: the most sensitive point g/M = 5.45e-7 GeV^-1 at m = 0.15 eV for pseudoscalar ALPs; the full exclusion curve is only available as a plot, so a single data point is emitted.
